calls.title: Disable Sticky Bucketing Flow
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the need for a clearer user interface (UI) for bandit settings. Michael Samper is tasked with cleaning up the current UI, reorganizing field placements as highlighted by Kari Kay, which caused confusion. A new section will group related controls like exploratory stage and update cadence, enhancing logical flow. Additional features like a toggle to disable sticky bucketing will include help text to prevent misuse. The discussion also covered improving warning visibility, emphasizing that warnings should use banner-style callouts for better clarity and context. Michael committed to consulting Luke on outstanding questions, while Kari is prepared to implement UI updates swiftly after receiving guidance.
calls.keywords: sticky bucketing, conversion window override, bandit settings, update cadence, exploratory stage, UI cleanup
calls.action_items:
**Michael Samper**
Pull up UI interface during discussions to clarify question relevance regarding sticky bucketing and conversion window override (01:11)
Consult with Luke regarding the rationale for the 'disable sticky bucketing' option frequency and conversion window override default behavior (02:51)
Initiate UI cleanup of the experiment assignment table specifically focused on improving styling, grouping, and clarifying bandit settings per Luke’s request (15:25)
Communicate updated understanding and decisions from Luke to Kari for subsequent UI work (18:50)

**Kari Kay**
Provide clearer UX/UI direction including help text, tooltips, field grouping, and warnings for disable sticky bucketing and bandit settings related to conversion window and update cadence (03:03)
Create layout adjustments to reorder conversion window and update cadence fields for better logical flow and user comprehension (08:35)
Suggest adding reset to default button and information that conversion window override defaults to metric’s conversion window to aid user clarity (15:37)
Draft detailed documentation summarizing discussed UI improvements and nuances around conversion windows and overrides to review with Michael and team (17:48)
Complete and deliver UI updates within approximately 20 minutes following meeting discussion for prompt iteration (19:10)
